events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday on September 21st.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday Vibe
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track that truly captures his iconic swagger?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released (1975)
events.blurb: On October 1st, 1975, John Lennon released his iconic solo album 'Imagine', featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Imagine's Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since 'Imagine' dropped. A powerful message that still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released (2001)
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on October 3rd, 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The first iPod landed 25 years ago today, changing how we listened to music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond's Best
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, which Bond film or song is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday on October 9th.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring artistry and vision of John Lennon. A true legend.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday on October 27th.

angles.name: Cleese's Comedy
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment from the comedy icon?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 2nd, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since 'The White Album' dropped. An incredible, sprawling masterpiece from The Beatles. What's your standout track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: November 24th marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years today, we lost a true icon. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3rd, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: An album that changed the game. 'Rubber Soul' by The Beatles is 61 years old today. Which track from this classic stands out for you?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: December 8th marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music legend John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Forty-six years on, the music and message of John Lennon continue to inspire. Remembering a true visionary today.
